verdict.rationale: DBOS supports event/queue-driven workflow triggering via queues (managed concurrency, flow control) and cron-based scheduling, and a real Kafka-consumer customer built an event-processing pipeline that runs workflows per message, which is direct evidence of queue-triggered fan-out. However, there is no explicit documentation of a declarative webhook-trigger decorator or of one event fanning out to multiple distinct downstream functions—queues let many workflow instances run concurrently, but 'one event -> many functions' fan-out semantics are not directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit webhook/HTTP-trigger annotation docs, explicit multi-function fan-out example from a single event, and independent confirmation beyond one customer anecdote.
